changes.comment: Hydration helpers for prerendered pages: `fetchRecord()` answers identical GET / HEAD requests from the page's hydration island, as many as the prerender made, `replaceNonTemplateChildren()` takes `{ identity }` (from `templateIdentity()` / `htmlIdentity()`) and returns `"adopted"` when the server already rendered that source, `holdHydration()` keeps hydration open for start-up work and `whenHydrated()` resolves when it ends
